'''Melih Onuş''' (8 February 1981 – 10 September 2020) was a Turkish [[mathematician]], [[Computer engineering|computer engineer]] and [[scientist]]. He represented [[Turkey]] in 1998 and 1999, at the [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] and was awarded a bronze and a silver medal, respectively. He died in the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].

==Early life and education==
Melih Onuş, who spent his early years in Ankara, completed his primary education in Iltekin Primary School and his secondary education in [[Ankara Atatürk Anadolu Lisesi|Atatürk Anatolian High School]]. During his secondary education he represented Turkey at the 39th and 40th [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] and was awarded a bronze and a silver medal, respectively.<ref name="imo2">{{cite web|url=http://imo-official.org/participant_r.aspx?id=5219|title=International Mathematical Olympiad|accessdate=25 September 2020|work=imo-official.org|archive-date=8 December 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111208063431/http://imo-official.org/participant_r.aspx?id=5219|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 2003, he graduated from [[Bilkent University]] Computer Engineering Department by completing his [[Bachelor of Science|B.Sc.]] Between 2003 and 2005, he worked as a research assistant in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at [[Arizona State University]] in the United States. In the same period, in 2004, he attended a summer school in the Computer Science department at the [[ETH Zurich]]. In 2006, at [[Los Alamos National Laboratory]] in [[New Mexico]], he conducted his work with Hristo N. Djidjev entitled "A Scalable and Accurate Graph Clustering and Community Structure Detection".<ref name="RG1">{{cite web |title=A scalable multilevel algorithm for community structure detection |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/239587793 |website=ResearchGate |accessdate=27 September 2020}}</ref>  After completing his doctorate study entitled "Overlay Network Construction in Decentralized Networks" at Arizona State University under the supervision of Dr. Andr´ea W. Richa he returned to Turkey.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=|title=Melih Onuş Bilkent CV|url=http://www.cs.bilkent.edu.tr/~onus/ozgecmis.pdf|access-date=|website=|publisher=}}</ref>

== Academic career ==
After returning to Turkey, he worked at [[TOBB University of Economics and Technology|TOBB University]], [[Bilkent University]] and [[Çankaya University]] Computer Engineering Departments. He continued his academic life at [[Bartın University]] from 2016 until his death.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|date=|title=Melih Onuş Bartın CV|url=https://cdn.bartin.edu.tr/bilgisayar/236b87c532bc4a17e3c2f24959e60229/melihonuscv2018.pdf|access-date=|website=|publisher=}}</ref>

== Death ==
Melih Onuş was infected with [[COVID-19]], while visiting his family in Ankara amid [[COVID-19 pandemic]] in 2020. He died at a hospital in Ankara on 10 September 2020.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sozcu.com.tr/2020/saglik/genc-akademisyen-corona-kurbani-6033373/|title=Genç akademisyen corona kurbanı|accessdate=25 September 2020|language=tr|work=www.sozcu.com.tr|date=11 September 2020 }}</ref> His father died 3 days later also from the virus. Both were buried in  Ankara Ortaköy Cemetery.{{citation needed|date=September 2020}}<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Ankara Mezarlık Bilgi Sistemi|url=https://mebis.ankara.bel.tr/|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100814150258/https://mebis.ankara.bel.tr/|archive-date=2010-08-14|access-date=|website=}}</ref>

== Research works ==
Some of Melih Onuş's works that are accepted in the international community are as follows:<ref name=":0"/><ref name=":1"/>
# Onus, M. ve Richa, A.W.(2016). "Parameterized maximum and average degree approximation in topic based publish subscribe overlay network design" Computer Networks 94: 307–317.
# Djidjev, H. ve Onus, M.(2013). "Scalable and Accurate Graph Clustering and Community Structure Detection" IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems 24 (5): 1022- 1029.
# Onus, M. ve Richa, A.W.(2011). "Minimum Maximum Degree Publish Subscribe Overlay Network Design" IEEE-ACM Transactions on Networking 19 (5) 1331–1343.
# Onus, M. ve Richa, A.W.(2010). "Parameterized Maximum and Average Degree Approximation in Topic Based Publish Subscribe Overlay Network Design" International Conference on Distributed Computing Systems (ICDCS), Genova, Italy.
# Onus, M. ve Richa, A.W.(2009). "Minimum Maximum Degree Publish Subscribe Overlay Network Design" IEEE International Conference on Computer Communications(INFOCOM), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
# Onus M., Richa A.W. ve Scheideler C.(2007). "Linearization Locally Self Stabilizing Sorting in Graphs" Workshop on Algorithm Engineering and Experiments (ALENEX), New Orleans, Louisiana, USA.
# Kothapalli K., Scheideler C., Onus M. ve Schindelhauer C.(2006). "Distributed Coloring in O(log n) bit rounds" International Parallel and Distributed Processing Symposium(IPDPS), Rhodes Island, Greece.
